ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which life cycle has a metamorphosis stage?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: There are two side-by-side life cycle diagrams in the figure. On the left is the plant life cycle, where seeds, a sprouting small plant, and a grown plant can be seen. On the right is the insect life cycle, where eggs or an early stage, a caterpillar-like larva, a pupa, and an adult insect can be seen. Reasoning: The question asks which life cycle has a metamorphosis stage. Metamorphosis usually refers to the morphological change of an insect from larva to pupa and then to adult, rather than the process of a plant growing from a seed into a plant. Therefore, the one with a metamorphosis stage is the insect life cycle on the right.
